attempts.result: Both train-selected directions fail train, validation and OOS at base cost; median duration about four hours.
Forcing a 24/48-hour minimum channel hold does not repair the edge because 3-ATR stops close trades after roughly 10-15 hours; both directions remain negative at base cost in every split.

inference: The tested GBPUSD M15 breakout mechanisms have no gross edge large enough for Ostium-compatible execution. Parameter expansion would be post-hoc rescue, not independent evidence.

policy.next_action: Deprioritize GBPUSD and test a distinct low-turnover mechanism or another already mapped Ostium market under a new preregistration.
